findings.headline: Migrate this startTransition call to Solid 2 built-in transitions.
findings.why: Solid 2 removes startTransition; use built-in transition batching with isPending() to observe in-flight state.
findings.guidance: Remove the startTransition wrapper. The callback's writes are batched automatically. Add isPending() checks where the caller previously observed the pending boolean.

findings.headline: Migrate this useTransition call to Solid 2 built-in transitions.
findings.why: Solid 2 removes useTransition; use isPending() and Loading boundaries to track transition state.
findings.guidance: Replace useTransition() with isPending(fn) at each site that previously read the pending flag. Wrap the JSX with Loading boundaries for in-flight fallback UI.

findings.headline: Review this createDeferred call against its Solid 2 meaning.
findings.why: Solid ${SOLID_TARGET_VERSION} keeps the createDeferred name with a new meaning: an async memo that may lag but never leads, keeping its last answer while a refetch is in flight (isPending reports the refetch). The 1.x idle-time deferral and the timeoutMs option are gone, and with a synchronous function it behaves like createMemo.
findings.guidance: Decide whether the call wanted idle-time deferral (replace with a plain createMemo or a direct read of the source, since values update after the microtask flush) or lag-tolerant async derivation (keep createDeferred, drop any timeoutMs option, and observe refetches with isPending).
